text: Sinthan Top is a mountain pass, a popular tourist destination located in Kishtwar district and borders with South Kashmir's Breng Valley (Sub-District Kokernag) of Anantnag district in the Indian union territory of Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region. Majority of the area lies on the Kishtwar side. The top acts as a  sort of base camp to several alpine lakes in the region.
best_time: March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views)
